factCards.text: Four, released in November 2014, made the group the first band whose first four albums all entered the Billboard 200 at number one.
Their 2013 Comic Relief single set Blondie's One Way or Another against the Undertones' Teenage Kicks and reached number one in the United Kingdom.
The group's last performance before the break came on the X Factor UK final in December 2015; the announcement earlier that year had described the pause as a hiatus rather than an end.
